_comment: Cards that exist only for the may-acceptance test (tests/unit/choices/test_may_memory.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_snort` is Snort's shape: each player MAY wheel, then each opponent who accepted takes 5. `t_snort_by_cards` is the near-miss that derives the set from the cards discarded, and so spares an opponent who accepted with an empty hand -- the very player a wheel is aimed at.

cards.name: Test Snort
cards.oracle_text: Each player may discard their hand and draw five cards. Then this spell deals 5 damage to each opponent who discarded their hand this way.

effects.prompt: Discard your hand and draw five?

cards.name: Test Snort By Cards
cards.oracle_text: Each player may discard their hand and draw five cards. Then this spell deals 5 damage to each opponent who discarded their hand this way.

effects.prompt: Discard your hand and draw five?
